# temps_project_group_variable (Resource)

An environment variable every project in a project group receives. The API returns a value only when it is written (lists show `***`, and never a secret's value), so a value changed outside Terraform is not detected.

Import with `<group_id>/<variable_id>`; set `value` in configuration afterwards.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `environments:read`, `environments:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every project in the group gets this variable.
resource "temps_project_group_variable" "region" {
  group_id         = temps_project_group.web.id
  key              = "REGION"
  value            = "eu-west"
  environment_slug = "production"
}

resource "temps_project_group_variable" "api_token" {
  group_id  = temps_project_group.web.id
  key       = "SHARED_API_TOKEN"
  value     = var.shared_api_token
  is_secret = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the project group.
- `key` (String) Variable name. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value.

### Optional

- `environment_slug` (String) Only give the variable to this environment of each project (for example `production`); every environment when omitted. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `include_in_preview` (Boolean) Also give the variable to preview environments. Defaults to `false`.
- `is_secret` (Boolean) Hide the value in the API and console. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<group_id>/<variable_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <group_id>/<variable_id>
terraform import temps_project_group_variable.region 3/41
```
